Ai._comment: Keys go in appsettings.Production.json. Groq is asked first, Gemini is the backup; either one alone also works.

FuelPrice._comment: Only 95 is regulated: the Ministry of Energy sets it nationally and updates it at midnight before the first working day of each month (https://www.gov.il/en/pages/fuel_prices_xls). 98 and diesel are free-market and vary 20-30% between stations — update them from a real receipt. 98 from the Paz and Dor Alon price lists and diesel from Delek, both 02/08/2026.
